verdicts.reason: Both shrink the Quillbrook logo to a tiny badge stuck at the bottom, and both put the CTA over a halo circle that is cut off at the right edge. A also sets the 'Whole bean or ground to order' fine print almost as large as the body copy, which wrecks the hierarchy and leaves a loose stack of badge and logo underneath. B has a bigger headline and a tighter bottom row of badge, logo and fine print. Its flaws are the headline break 'slow / roasted.', which splits the phrase, and fine print so small it is barely legible.
